text:
sasha: scan-bot picked up a DAST finding from the staging run: unauthenticated access to /_health/proxy returning internal metrics. tagging @ben @karen. :grimacing:
ben: link and snippet?
sasha: https://scans.redwood/2026/04/12/health-proxy.json and snippet:
```
GET /_health/proxy 200 OK
Response contains: {"uptime_ms":..., "db_connections":..., "internal_version":"rev-732"}
```
karen: I added a temporary reverse-proxy passthrough last week for smoke tests, may have skipped auth for that path. not hitting prod.
sam: can we prove which build artifact was deployed to staging? product security wants KMS audit for the signing key. which key did deploy pipeline use?
sasha: CI metadata shows key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/deploy/cryptoKeys/sign-key.
kms-bot: suggested query to collect decrypt events:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\" AND protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"deploy\" AND timestamp>\"2026-04-12T00:00:00Z\"" --limit 50
```
ben: AsymmetricSign is used for artifact signatures, good. I'll pull logs and attach to ticket SEC-2310.
karen: short-term fix: re-enable auth on /_health/* and deploy hotfix. i'll send PR now.
sasha: also add a premerge SAST/DAST check to flag any routes under /_internal, /_admin, /_health that are missing auth in unit tests.
scan-bot: (system) nightly DAST run: 1 HIGH (exposed internal metrics), 0 MED, 2 LOW. report attached.
sam: follow-ups: (1) attach KMS sign logs to SEC-2310 (2) add smoke test in deploy pipeline to hit /_health/proxy and assert 401 (3) add RBAC change checklist entry to avoid accidental bypasses.
kms-bot: note: ensure logs include job_id and deploy_id in request metadata so we can correlate.
ben: PR merged and hotfix deployed, monitoring for 2h.
sasha: thanks. marking ticket mitigated after KMS evidence attached and 2h quiet.
karen: will open RFC to make health endpoints auth-by-default.
sam: I'll add the KMS alert rule draft (threshold on AsymmetricSign for deploy key).
sasha: closing thread, will update SEC-2310.
